ollamaBaseUrl.label: Ollama Base URL
ollamaBaseUrl.description: URL of the Ollama server (e.g. http://localhost:11434).

chatModel.label: Chat Model
chatModel.description: Ollama model for chat. Recommended: qwen3:8b (best tool calling). Alternatives: granite3.3-dense:8b, llama3.1:8b.

embedModel.label: Embedding Model
embedModel.description: Ollama model for document embeddings (RAG). Default: nomic-embed-text.

maxContextChunks.label: Max Context Chunks
maxContextChunks.description: Maximum number of document chunks included as context.

quantizationHelp.title: Model Quantization Guide
quantizationHelp.q8: Q8_0 — Best quality (~8.5 GB RAM). Use if RAM allows.
quantizationHelp.q5: Q5_K_M — Balanced (~5.5 GB RAM). Recommended for production.
quantizationHelp.q4: Q4_K_M — Low memory (~4.5 GB RAM). Tool calling accuracy may decrease.
quantizationHelp.tip: Example: Use "qwen3:8b-q5_k_m" for balanced quality/memory. Minimum Q5 recommended for tool calling.

success.title: Settings saved
success.description: AI settings have been updated. Model changes will take effect shortly.
